Title: Ayaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ayaan - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Neeta - 37 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Riya - 9 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress
4. Naira - 12 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
5. Vimla - 64 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Ayaan stands in the park. Neeta, Riya and Vimla stand near him.]

Riya: "Grandma, what's the plan today?"

[Ayaan goes jogging in the park.]

Ayaan: "Okay, Mom."

[Ayaan throws the ball to Mother.]

Ayaan: "Oh wow!"

[Ayaan catches the ball.]

Neeta: "What next?"

[Ayaan plays cricket in the park.]

Neeta: "Mother, listen!"

[Ayaan goes down the slide.]

Riya: "I'm ready!"

[Ayaan plays with his dog.]

Riya: "Okay, Grandma."

[Ayaan does push-ups.]

Ayaan: "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Ayaan: "So, here we are!"

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Ayaan: "Yes, all right."

[Flower petals rain down on Ayaan.]

Ayaan (happily): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Ayaan: "That's easy."

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Ayaan (laughing): "That was fun!"

[Ayaan lights a bonfire.]

Riya: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Ayaan stands in the living room. Neeta, Riya and Naira stand near him.]

Neeta: "Let's begin."

[Ayaan sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Riya (laughing): "Naira, look at this."

[Ayaan mops the floor.]

Naira: "What happened?"

[Ayaan irons his school shirt.]

Riya: "One more time!"

Scene 4: The kitchen - Day

[Ayaan stands in the kitchen. Neeta and Vimla stand near him.]

Neeta: "What a nice place."

[Ayaan makes tea for everyone.]

Vimla: "Good job, Ayaan!"

[Ayaan chops onions for the curry.]

Ayaan: "What next?"

[Ayaan washes the dishes after dinner.]

Vimla: "That was such a fun day!"
